lesson_questions.question: Which Egyptian god was known as the King of the Gods and gained more power when combined with Ra?
options: Amun with the head of a ram
Bastet with the head of a cat
Geb with the head of a goose
Anubis with the head of a jackal
lesson_questions.correct_answer: Amun with the head of a ram
expected_points: Amun was known as the King of the Gods and gained more power when combined with Ra.
lesson_questions.source_quote: Amun, King of the Gods. When Amun was combined with Ra he was even more powerful.

lesson_questions.question: Which Egyptian goddess was associated with protection and household entertainment and depicted with the head of a cat?
options: Anubis with the head of a jackal
Bastet with the head of a cat
Amun with the head of a ram
Geb with the head of a goose
lesson_questions.correct_answer: Bastet with the head of a cat
expected_points: Bastet was associated with protection and household entertainment and depicted with the head of a cat.
lesson_questions.source_quote: Bastet, Protection and the household entertainment. Daughter of Ra. Head of a cat

lesson_questions.question: Which Egyptian god was symbolized with the head of a crocodile and associated with fertility and protection?
options: Sobek with the head of a crocodile
Thoth with the head of a bird
Hathor with the head of a cow
Sekhmet with the head of a lioness
lesson_questions.correct_answer: Sobek with the head of a crocodile
expected_points: Sobek was symbolized with the head of a crocodile and associated with fertility and protection.
lesson_questions.source_quote: Sobek, God of the Nile. Head of a crocodile
